rows.label: DITTY

rows.label: NUMBERING

rows.label: FANFARE

rows.clue: Plausible glib talk (especially useful to a salesperson)

rows.label: RADIO NEWS

rows.label: COOKBOOK

rows.label: DRONING

rows.label: RED LIGHT

rows.label: PROSE

rows.clue: A newspaper or official journal

rows.label: CHAIN LETTER

rows.label: SENTENCE

rows.label: CURRICULUM

rows.label: EXPOSITION
